visualCharacteristics.purpose: Compact label | value reference table such as a BMI classification list
visualCharacteristics.layout: Two columns, no header row, no borders or stripes; bold navy label in the first column spans the rows below it; values in the second column with bold class names
visualCharacteristics.typography: Apis, navy, 16px mobile / 18px desktop, line-height ~1.17; label and class names bold

contentPattern.structure: One row per data row, one cell per column. No header row: the first row is data. Fill the first cell of the first row with the label and leave the first cell of following rows empty; it becomes a row header spanning those rows
contentPattern.sourceDescription: BMI Classification | **Underweight** — Below 18.5 kg/m², then five more rows (Normal, Overweight, Obesity Class I-III) with an empty first cell

usage: BMI classification list on the What is obesity page.
reuseGuidance: Use for short two-column reference lists without a header row. Use the plain table block when the data has column headings or needs rules.
